capabilities: Apply Chinese contract layout and fonts
Generate a cover page from note blocks
Embed images and resolve wiki links
extras: Self-contained (no Python or external converter) and works on desktop and mobile. Fonts are written by name, not embedded, so if a font is missing Word substitutes another and pagination can change. Cover page requires cssclasses: contract-pdf and five specific opening blocks; incomplete blocks export without a cover and show a warning. Install instructions say 'Once the plugin is in the community directory,' implying it is not yet listed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export a note as a Word .docx file, and no option for a Chinese contract page layout.
summary: Word document exporter that converts an Obsidian note to a .docx file with a Chinese contract layout (A4, cover page, page numbers).
